title: Linking smallholders to markets: Understanding how agricultural production outsourcing is linked to crop commercialization in China
title_zh: 小农户与市场对接：理解农业生产外包如何影响中国农作物商业化
title_primary: 小农户与市场对接：理解农业生产外包如何影响中国农作物商业化
title_secondary: Linking smallholders to markets: Understanding how agricultural production outsourcing is linked to crop commercialization in China
authors: Xingyi Zuo, Houjian Li, Ya Cheng, Cheng Wang, Andi Cao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural commercialization represents a critical pathway for smallholders to integrate into modern markets. Yet fragmented landholdings, an aging rural workforce, and high transaction costs continue to constrain smallholders’ market participation. Drawing on data from the China Land Economic Survey (CLES) from 2020 to 2022, this study examines the association between agricultural production outsourcing and smallholder commercialization, measured by the crop commercialization index. The analysis employs an instrumental variable strategy that exploits peer-driven variation in village-level outsourcing adoption, complemented by robustness checks under alternative identifying assumptions. The results show that outsourcing adoption is positively associated with the degree of smallholder commercialization. Mechanism analysis suggests three potential pathways associated with this relationship: higher mechanization intensity, larger operational scale, and greater crop diversification. Heterogeneity analyses indicate stronger associations for harvesting and labor-saving services and among younger farmers, whereas land fragmentation attenuates the relationship. These findings extend research on agricultural outsourcing from production-side outcomes to market integration and highlight the potential role of agricultural service systems in smallholder commercialization.
abstract_zh: 农业商业化是小农户融入现代市场的重要途径。然而，土地细碎化、农村劳动力老龄化以及高昂的交易成本持续制约着小农户的市场参与。本研究利用2020至2022年中国土地经济调查（CLES）数据，考察农业生产经营外包与小农户商业化程度（以作物商业化指数衡量）之间的关联。分析采用工具变量策略，利用村级外包采纳中的同伴驱动变异，并在替代识别假设下进行稳健性检验。结果表明，外包采纳与小农户商业化程度呈正相关。机制分析提示，这一关联可能通过三条潜在路径实现：机械化强度提高、经营规模扩大以及作物多样化程度提升。异质性分析显示，收割类及节省劳动力类服务的作用更为显著，且对年轻农户的影响更强，而土地细碎化则会削弱这一关联。这些发现将农业外包研究从生产侧结果拓展至市场整合层面，并凸显了农业服务体系在小农户商业化中的潜在作用。

title: Natural Resources, Democracy, and Labour-Market Outcomes in the Public Sector
title_zh: 自然资源、民主与公共部门劳动力市场结果
title_primary: 自然资源、民主与公共部门劳动力市场结果
title_secondary: Natural Resources, Democracy, and Labour-Market Outcomes in the Public Sector
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Governments in resource-rich countries may use a sizable share of the revenue from their underground wealth to buy support through public employment. This occurs in both democratic governments (which need to be re-elected) and autocratic governments (which have to prevent riots and regime change). Using the Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators dataset provided by the World Bank, we analyse the effect of natural resources on public employment in developing countries from 2000 to 2018. We find that resource rents may have an effect on public sector characteristics. However, uncovering the heterogeneous effects of different types of natural resources, we find that oil and gas wealth may increase public employment in countries that are not fully democratic, while forest wealth has a positive impact for all values of democracy. At the same time, the public sector wage premium is positively affected by oil and forest in non-democratic countries and by gas when the level of democracy is very high.
abstract_zh: 资源丰富的国家政府可能会利用其地下财富带来的可观收入，通过公共就业来购买支持。这种现象既出现在民主政府（需寻求连任）中，也出现在专制政府（需防止骚乱与政权更迭）中。利用世界银行提供的全球官僚体系指标数据集，我们分析了2000年至2018年间自然资源对发展中国家公共就业的影响。我们发现，资源租金可能对公共部门特征产生影响。然而，通过揭示不同类型自然资源的异质性效应，我们发现石油和天然气财富可能增加非完全民主国家的公共就业，而森林财富对所有民主程度的国家均有积极影响。同时，公共部门的工资溢价在非民主国家中受到石油和森林资源的正向影响，而在民主程度极高时，则受到天然气资源的正向影响。

title: Value allocation in two-sided markets
title_zh: 双边市场中的价值分配
title_primary: 双边市场中的价值分配
title_secondary: Value allocation in two-sided markets
authors: Wonki Jo Cho, Juan D. Moreno-Ternero
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study value allocation in two-sided markets (such as payment cards, streaming platforms, online travel booking sites, ride-sharing apps, and search engines). We characterize two focal classes of allocation rules (premium-augmented Shapley solutions and premium-augmented equal-division solutions) with strong normative underpinnings. A common feature of these classes is that they permit favorable treatment to only one side of the market. Our characterized rules provide rationale for familiar practices of platforms in real life, which charge one side (say, sellers) of the market while subsidizing the other side (buyers) in various ways (e.g., coupons and discounts).
abstract_zh: 我们研究双边市场（如支付卡、流媒体平台、在线旅行预订网站、拼车应用和搜索引擎）中的价值分配问题。我们刻画了两类具有坚实规范基础的分配规则（溢价增强的沙普利解和溢价增强的均分解）。这两类规则的共同特点是允许仅对市场一方给予优惠待遇。我们所刻画的规则为现实中平台常见的做法提供了理论依据，即向市场一方（如卖家）收费，同时以各种方式（如优惠券和折扣）补贴另一方（买家）。

title: When Is the Trend the Cycle?
title_zh: 趋势何时即周期？
title_primary: 趋势何时即周期？
title_secondary: When Is the Trend the Cycle?
authors: Dan Cao, Jean-Paul L’Huillier, Donghoon Yoo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A literature debates the explanations for the cyclical properties of emerging markets using either trend shocks Aguiar and Gopinath (2007) or financial frictions Garcia-Cicco et al. (2010); Neumeyer and Perri (2004). We state a formal proposition that makes explicit the parametric assumptions needed for consumption to behave (exactly) as in a random-walk, permanent income model. The result is general and applies to economies with endogenous investment and production. The proposition offers a fresh perspective on the debate regarding the sources of emerging market fluctuations, and reconciles diverging findings in the literature. Moreover, we quantitatively explore the business cycle properties of the RBC model when one moves away from the parametric assumptions suggested by the proposition.
abstract_zh: 关于新兴市场周期属性的解释，文献中存在两种观点：一种强调趋势冲击（Aguiar和Gopinath，2007），另一种则侧重于金融摩擦（Garcia-Cicco等，2010；Neumeyer和Perri，2004）。我们提出一个正式命题，明确阐述了使消费行为（精确地）符合随机游走、永久收入模型所需的参数假设。该结果具有普遍性，适用于包含内生投资和生产的经济体。这一命题为关于新兴市场波动来源的辩论提供了新视角，并调和了文献中的分歧发现。此外，我们定量探讨了当偏离命题所建议的参数假设时，RBC模型的商业周期特性。

title: The Inflation Accelerator
title_zh: 通货膨胀加速器
title_primary: 通货膨胀加速器
title_secondary: The Inflation Accelerator
authors: Blanco, Andres, Boar, Corina, Jones, Callum, Midrigan, Virgiliu
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We develop a tractable sticky price model in which the fraction of price changes evolves endogenously over time and, consistent with the evidence, increases with inflation. Because we assume that firms sell multiple products and choose how many, but not which, prices to adjust in every period, our model admits exact aggregation and reduces to a one-equation extension of the Calvo model. The model features a powerful inflation accelerator–a feedback loop between inflation and the fraction of price changes–which significantly increases the slope of the Phillips curve during periods of high inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个易于处理的粘性价格模型，其中价格变动的比例随时间内生演变，并且与实证证据一致，随通胀上升而增加。由于我们假设企业销售多种产品，并在每期选择调整多少价格而非哪些价格，我们的模型实现了精确加总，并简化为卡尔沃模型的一个单方程扩展。该模型具有强大的通胀加速器效应——通胀与价格变动比例之间的反馈循环——这在高通胀时期显著增大了菲利普斯曲线的斜率。

title: We Don't Need No Education: The Effect of Income Shocks on Human Capital in Africa
title_zh: 我们不需要教育：收入冲击对非洲人力资本的影响
title_primary: 我们不需要教育：收入冲击对非洲人力资本的影响
title_secondary: We Don't Need No Education: The Effect of Income Shocks on Human Capital in Africa
official: 官方在线 2024-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore the effects of early life income shocks on human capital using oil price fluctuations in a large sample of relevant African countries and employing micro data from multiple waves of the Demographic and Health Survey (DHS). Such shocks enable human capital investment via the standard income effect; but also crowd it out because of substitutability between natural resource and human capital income sources. The relative strength of the two effects depends on the age at which the shock is experienced. Consistent with these insights, we find that income shocks in early life are associated with enhanced educational attainment and wealth but are sometimes linked to reduced levels of such outcomes if experienced in adolescence. These results survive multiple robustness checks, and their broader implications are discussed.
abstract_zh: 我们利用多个非洲相关国家的大样本数据及人口与健康调查（DHS）多轮微观数据，探讨了早期生命阶段收入冲击对人力资本的影响，这些冲击源于石油价格波动。此类冲击通过标准的收入效应促进人力资本投资；但同时，由于自然资源与人力资本收入来源之间的可替代性，也可能挤出这种投资。两种效应的相对强度取决于冲击发生的年龄阶段。与这些见解一致，我们发现，早期生命中的收入冲击与教育成就和财富的提升相关联，但若在青春期经历，有时则与这些结果的降低有关。这些结果通过了多项稳健性检验，并讨论了其更广泛的意义。

title: Perceived Budget Constraint of the Government
title_zh: 政府感知预算约束
title_primary: 政府感知预算约束
title_secondary: Perceived Budget Constraint of the Government
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide direct evidence on how the public expects the government to satisfy its intertemporal budget constraint. In a representative survey of U.S. households, respondents expect only 45% of government debt to be financed by future primary surpluses and 23% to be rolled over indefinitely without ever generating surpluses, as if sustained by a bubble. Experts perceive an even larger bubble (37%). Beliefs respond to fundamentals: at a debt-to-GDP ratio of 150%, the perceived bubble shrinks to 15%. A New Keynesian model calibrated to these beliefs implies a 13% larger government spending multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于公众如何预期政府满足其跨期预算约束的直接证据。在一项具有代表性的美国家庭调查中，受访者预期仅有45%的政府债务将由未来基本盈余融资，而23%的债务将被无限期滚动而不产生任何盈余，仿佛由泡沫支撑。专家感知到的泡沫更大（37%）。信念对基本面因素有所反应：当债务与GDP之比达到150%时，感知到的泡沫缩小至15%。一个根据这些信念校准的新凯恩斯模型显示，政府支出乘数将增加13%。

title: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 美元主导地位与货币政策的传导
title_primary: 美元主导地位与货币政策的传导
title_secondary: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
abstract_zh: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否已使货币政策失效？一种新兴观点认为，若一国以美元计价其出口，汇率便无法稳定经济活动，因为传统的支出转换渠道被削弱。这一观点基于出口价格以美元粘性设定的前提，从而切断了出口需求与货币贬值之间的联系。然而，这一假设并未得到数据支持：以美元计价的商品往往具有更灵活的价格，同时伴随更高的替代弹性。我们提出了一个基于更现实假设的模型，并表明即使采用美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍能显著促进出口和经济增长。扩张的任何限制并非来自需求，而是供给能力。我们还证明，汇率对美元价格的低传导率并不能反映价格粘性。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也较小：低传导率是均衡结果，而非名义摩擦的证据。

title: Quality vs. quantity when time is scarce
title_zh: 时间稀缺下的质量与数量权衡
title_primary: 时间稀缺下的质量与数量权衡
title_secondary: Quality vs. quantity when time is scarce
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How do consumers decide between quality and quantity, and what drives heterogeneity in quality choice? This paper introduces a tractable model of consumer choice in which quality sorting emerges endogenously from wage heterogeneity in the presence of time opportunity costs of consumption. Consumers must allocate more time to consume larger quantities, while quality allows consumers to increase utility without affecting their time budget constraints. The model predicts that higher-wage consumers choose higher quality while higher-wealth consumers choose higher quantity. This leads consumers to view quality and quantity as distinct concepts and offers a tractable alternative to discrete choice models, explicitly incorporating both dimensions.
abstract_zh: 消费者如何在质量与数量之间做出选择，以及什么因素驱动质量选择的异质性？本文引入了一个易于处理的消费者选择模型，其中质量排序在存在消费时间机会成本的情况下，由工资异质性内生地产生。消费者必须分配更多时间来消费更大数量，而质量则允许消费者在不影响其时间预算约束的情况下增加效用。模型预测，高工资消费者选择更高质量，而高财富消费者选择更大数量。这导致消费者将质量与数量视为不同概念，并为离散选择模型提供了一种易于处理的替代方案，明确纳入这两个维度。

title: Leading green paths: the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on corporate green mergers and acquisitions
title_zh: 引领绿色路径：高管环境背景对企业绿色并购的影响
title_primary: 引领绿色路径：高管环境背景对企业绿色并购的影响
title_secondary: Leading green paths: the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on corporate green mergers and acquisitions
authors: Zhensheng Li, Jinliang Wang, Zhuoyang Lyu, Jinlan Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Green mergers and acquisitions (M&A) represent a pivotal strategy for corporate sustainable transition. Using data from Chinese A-share listed companies (2010–2024), this study examines how executives’ environmental backgrounds shape green M&A decisions and outcomes. The results show that executives’ environmental backgrounds significantly drive companies’ green M&A activities, and the promoting effect is more significant when the executives hold greater power. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the impact of executives’ environmental backgrounds on green M&A varies contingent on firm characteristics and financing constraints. The promoting effect is more pronounced for state-owned enterprises and enterprises with a high proportion of institutional ownership, yet no significant difference is observed between heavily polluting and non-heavily polluting firms. However, the impact is statistically insignificant for enterprises facing tight external financing constraints, regardless of whether the financing channel is debt financing or equity financing. Further analysis indicates that green M&A generates short-term market reactions, boosting cumulative abnormal returns. Furthermore, this study finds that the executives’ environmental backgrounds can significantly improve enterprises’ environmental and economic performance following green M&A activities. Overall, these findings illuminate the internal governance mechanisms driving corporate green transformation.
abstract_zh: 绿色并购是企业可持续转型的关键战略。基于2010-2024年中国A股上市公司数据，本文考察高管环保背景如何影响绿色并购决策与成效。研究发现：高管环保背景显著推动企业绿色并购活动，且当高管权力较大时，这种促进作用更为显著。异质性分析表明，高管环保背景对绿色并购的影响因企业特征与融资约束而异：国有企业及机构持股比例较高企业的促进作用更显著，但重污染与非重污染企业间未呈现显著差异；然而，当企业面临较强外部融资约束时（无论融资渠道为债务融资还是股权融资），该影响在统计上不显著。进一步分析显示，绿色并购能产生短期市场反应，提升累计异常收益率。此外，本文发现高管环保背景可显著改善企业绿色并购后的环境绩效与经济绩效。总体而言，这些发现揭示了驱动企业绿色转型的内部治理机制。

title: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
title_zh: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析
title_primary: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析
title_secondary: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
authors: Agudamu Qi, Ying Yuan, Peng Liu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores the high- and low-volatility spillover effects and portfolio allocation from a frequency-domain perspective across the stock, bond, forex, gold, and oil markets. Specifically, we decompose realized volatility into high- and low-volatility regimes and analyse volatility spillovers from both short- and long-term components using the TVP-VAR frequency connectedness approach. In addition, we employ four portfolio strategies to evaluate cumulative returns and hedging effectiveness. This results reveal significant differences in spillover effects between high- and low-volatility networks: short-term spillovers dominate in high-volatility networks, whereas long-term spillovers are the main contributors in low-volatility networks. Furthermore, the portfolio constructed using the minimum connectedness approach (MCoP) exhibits the highest cumulative returns, whereas the minimum variance portfolio (MVP) and risk parity portfolio (RPP) achieve stronger hedging effectiveness. Overall, this study highlights the importance of jointly considering volatility intensity and time-frequency characteristics when assessing cross-market risk transmission and designing portfolio strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究从频域视角探讨了股票、债券、外汇、黄金及石油市场间的高、低波动溢出效应与资产配置策略。具体而言，我们将已实现波动率分解为高波动与低波动状态，并采用TVP-VAR频域关联方法，从短期与长期成分两个维度分析波动溢出效应。此外，我们运用四种投资组合策略评估累计收益与对冲有效性。研究结果显示，高波动与低波动网络中的溢出效应存在显著差异：高波动网络中短期溢出占主导地位，而低波动网络中长期溢出为主要贡献因素。进一步发现，基于最小关联法构建的投资组合（MCoP）具有最高的累计收益，而最小方差组合（MVP）与风险平价组合（RPP）则展现出更强的对冲有效性。总体而言，本研究强调了在评估跨市场风险传导与设计投资组合策略时，需同时考虑波动强度与时间-频率特征的重要性。

title: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions
title_zh: 企业退出与金融摩擦
title_primary: 企业退出与金融摩擦
title_secondary: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Governments often intervene to prevent firm closures during crises, fearing that financially constrained but viable firms may fail. We develop a firm dynamics model with incomplete financial markets and show how financial frictions generate excessive firm exit. A key statistic governing this dynamic inefficiency is the marginal propensity to exit with debt. Using confidential U.S. Census data, we estimate the relationship between debt and exit and use it to discipline the model. The calibrated model implies that eliminating financial frictions reduces firm exit from 9.3\% to 5.0\% and generates welfare gains of 3.6\% in consumption-equivalent terms. We show that the welfare costs of financial frictions rise sharply during financial crises but change little during standard productivity recessions. Finally, we compare government-guaranteed loans and grants, quantifying the trade-off between fiscal cost and effectiveness in preventing excessive exit.
abstract_zh: 政府常会在危机期间干预以防止企业倒闭，担心那些面临财务约束但具有生存能力的企业可能失败。我们构建了一个包含不完全金融市场的企业动态模型，并展示了金融摩擦如何导致企业过度退出。衡量这种动态低效率的关键统计指标是债务驱动的边际退出倾向。利用保密的美国人口普查数据，我们估算了债务与退出之间的关系，并以此校准模型。校准后的模型表明，消除金融摩擦可使企业退出率从9.3%降至5.0%，并以消费等价形式带来3.6%的福利收益。我们进一步发现，金融摩擦的福利成本在金融危机期间急剧上升，但在标准的生产率衰退期间变化甚微。最后，我们比较了政府担保贷款与直接拨款，量化了财政成本与防止过度退出有效性之间的权衡关系。

title: Public green spaces for urban sustainability: A quantitative socio-ecological analysis of impacts in Marrakech, Morocco
title_zh: 城市可持续性的公共绿地：摩洛哥马拉喀什影响的定量社会生态分析
title_primary: 城市可持续性的公共绿地：摩洛哥马拉喀什影响的定量社会生态分析
title_secondary: Public green spaces for urban sustainability: A quantitative socio-ecological analysis of impacts in Marrakech, Morocco
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study provides a socio-ecological and bioeconomic analysis of their multifunctional contribution to the sustainability of Marrakech, a city under strong natural pressures (climatic, etc) and human pressures (pollution, etc). Empirically, we quantify ecosystem services (thermal and hydrological regulation, sequestration and storage of pollutant gases ‘CO₂, CO, O₃, NO₂, SO₂, PM₂.₅ and PM₁₀’; O2 production…), as well as the associated socio-economic benefits. A mixed methodology combines hyperspectral remote sensing, GIS, bioeconomic modeling (i-Tree Eco), and field surveys (measurements; interviews using interview guides and questionnaires). A PCA analysis allows us to distinguish five ecological profiles among the studied sites. We also correlate managerial performance and governance with environmental effectiveness. These findings point to an ecological hierarchy, in particular, large wooded spaces such as the Palmeraie act as major carbon sinks (53760 t CO₂/year), and offer exceptional hydrological regulation (runoff reduction > 98%), On the other hand, the small gardens play a role in providing filtration of pollutants and cooling. Moreover, mathematical modeling demonstrates that governance mechanisms explain 64.26% of the variability in green space quality (R² = 0.646), highlighting that stakeholder participation, resource mobilization, and monitoring-evaluation are just as decisive as biophysical characteristics. Overall, the quantitative results confirm the pronounced multifunctionality of these areas, and highlight the significance of governance processes, efficiency, effectiveness, and satisfaction as major factors affecting the ecological performance of these areas. Finally, this research provides a new perspective on urban green areas by redefining them as a means of urban adaptation and environmental justice in Marrakech and similar cities.
abstract_zh: 本研究从社会生态与生物经济视角，分析了马拉喀什市多功能绿地对可持续性的贡献，该城市面临强烈自然压力（如气候）和人为压力（如污染）。实证上，我们量化了生态系统服务（热力与水文调节、污染物气体‘CO₂、CO、O₃、NO₂、SO₂、PM₂.₅和PM₁₀’的固存与储存、O₂产生等）及相关社会经济效益。采用混合方法，结合高光谱遥感、GIS、生物经济模型（i-Tree Eco）及实地调查（测量；使用访谈指南和问卷的访谈）。主成分分析（PCA）使我们能够区分研究地点中的五种生态特征。我们还将管理绩效和治理与环境有效性相关联。研究结果揭示了生态层级，特别是如帕尔默赖（Palmeraie）等大型林地作为主要碳汇（每年53760吨CO₂），并提供卓越的水文调节（径流减少>98%）；而小型花园则发挥污染物过滤和降温作用。此外，数学模型表明，治理机制解释了绿地质量变异的64.26%（R² = 0.646），强调利益相关者参与、资源动员和监测评估与生物物理特征同样具有决定性作用。总体而言，定量结果证实了这些区域显著的多功能性，并凸显治理过程、效率、有效性和满意度作为影响其生态表现的主要因素的重要性。最后，本研究通过将城市绿地重新定义为马拉喀什及类似城市中城市适应和环境正义的手段，提供了新的视角。

title: Design of Partial Population Experiments with an Application to Spillovers in Tax Compliance
title_zh: 部分总体实验设计及其在税收合规溢出效应中的应用

authors: Guillermo Cruces, Dario Tortarolo, Gonzalo Vazquez-Bare
official: 官方在线 2026-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a framework to analyze partial population experiments, a generalization of the cluster experimental design where clusters are assigned to different treatment intensities. The framework allows for heterogeneity in cluster sizes and outcome distributions. The paper studies the large-sample behavior of OLS estimators and cluster-robust variance estimators and shows that (i) ignoring cluster heterogeneity may result in severely underpowered experiments and (ii) the cluster-robust variance estimator may be upward-biased when clusters are heterogeneous. The paper derives formulas for power, minimum detectable effects, and optimal cluster assignment probabilities. All the results apply to cluster experiments, a particular case of the framework. The paper sets up a potential outcomes framework to interpret the OLS estimands as causal effects. It implements the methods in a large-scale experiment to estimate the direct and spillover effects of a communication campaign on property tax compliance. The analysis reveals an increase in tax compliance among individuals directly targeted with the mailing, as well as compliance spillovers on untreated individuals in clusters with a high proportion of treated taxpayers.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析部分总体实验的框架，这是对聚类实验设计的一种推广，其中聚类被分配至不同的处理强度。该框架允许聚类规模与结果分布存在异质性。本文研究了OLS估计量及聚类稳健方差估计量的大样本性质，并表明：（i）忽略聚类异质性可能导致实验统计功效严重不足；（ii）当聚类存在异质性时，聚类稳健方差估计量可能存在向上偏误。本文推导了统计功效、最小可检测效应及最优聚类分配概率的公式。所有结论均适用于聚类实验（该框架的一个特例）。本文构建了一个潜在结果框架，将OLS估计量解释为因果效应。通过一项大规模实验实施该方法，用以估计通信宣传对财产税合规性的直接效应与溢出效应。分析显示，直接收到邮件的个体税收合规性有所提升，且在受处理纳税人比例较高的聚类中，未受处理的个体也出现了合规性溢出效应。

title: Fertility, labor market participation, and macroeconomic dynamics
title_zh: 生育率、劳动力市场参与和宏观经济动态
title_primary: 生育率、劳动力市场参与和宏观经济动态
title_secondary: Fertility, labor market participation, and macroeconomic dynamics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a dynamic macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households, endogenous fertility, and endogenous labor market participation to study the two-way interactions between demographic change and economic growth. The model yields closed-form results in a simplified setting and is then calibrated to Japanese data from 1970 to 2019 to examine long-run trends and policy counterfactuals. We find that reducing participation costs increases employment but lowers GDP per worker and total population due to a negative spillover that increases childrearing costs; lowering the cost of raising children slows population decline but reduces GDP per capita mostly by expanding the non-working population; and faster productivity growth boosts GDP per capita and population growth, but reduces labor force participation through selection effects. Overall, fertility and labor market policies involve trade-offs—between participation and productivity or between growth and demographic stability. These trade-offs are mitigated by technological progress, which tends to enhance both economic and demographic outcomes; participation may decline via composition effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭、内生生育率和内生劳动参与率的动态宏观经济模型，以研究人口结构变化与经济增长之间的双向互动。该模型在简化设定下得出闭式解，并随后基于1970年至2019年的日本数据进行校准，以考察长期趋势和政策反事实分析。我们发现，降低参与成本会增加就业，但由于负向溢出效应提高了育儿成本，从而降低了人均GDP和总人口；降低抚养子女的成本会减缓人口下降，但主要通过扩大非劳动人口规模而降低人均GDP；更快的生产率增长提升了人均GDP和人口增长率，但通过选择效应降低了劳动参与率。总体而言，生育和劳动力市场政策涉及权衡——在参与率与生产率之间，或在增长与人口稳定性之间。这些权衡可通过技术进步得到缓解，技术进步往往同时改善经济与人口结果；但参与率可能因构成效应而下降。

title: When Free-Riding on Contributing to an Impurely Shared Good Decreases with Greater Concentration of Interests
title_zh: 当利益集中度提高时，对不纯公共品贡献的搭便车行为减少
title_primary: 当利益集中度提高时，对不纯公共品贡献的搭便车行为减少
title_secondary: When Free-Riding on Contributing to an Impurely Shared Good Decreases with Greater Concentration of Interests
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: While a well-developed conceptual foundation for understanding underinvestment in shared goods exists, how heterogeneity in interests among a group affects expenditures relative to the socially optimal level has received little scrutiny. We show that i) the majorization partial ordering is an appropriate way to think about heterogeneous interests, and ii) reasonable technologies exist where more concentration decreases expenditure at the intensive margin, i.e., when all group members spend. However, greater concentration of interests eventually leads to greater aggregate expenditure because the least interested cease spending, leaving the burden entirely on those with most interest.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于共享品投资不足的概念基础已相当完善，但群体内利益异质性如何影响支出相对于社会最优水平的研究却鲜有涉及。我们证明：i) 主化偏序是思考利益异质性的恰当方式；ii) 在合理的技术条件下，利益集中度的提高会在集约边际上减少支出，即当所有群体成员都进行支出时。然而，利益集中度的进一步增加最终会导致总支出上升，因为兴趣最低的成员停止支出，将负担完全留给兴趣最高的成员。

title: Can Online Activity Be Regulated? Evidence from Adult Websites
title_zh: 网络活动能否被监管？来自成人网站的证据
title_primary: 网络活动能否被监管？来自成人网站的证据
title_secondary: Can Online Activity Be Regulated? Evidence from Adult Websites
authors: Matthew Brown, Emily J. Davis, Devin G. Pope
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The consequences of online regulations depend on the extent to which users can circumvent restrictions or substitute toward noncompliant platforms. Since 2023, 25 U.S. states have implemented age verification laws that caused prominent adult websites (including Pornhub) to restrict local access for all users. We study how these restrictions affected browsing activity using individual-level panel data. Access restrictions reduced overall time spent on adult sites by roughly 10%. Specifically, for every 100 hours spent on top adult sites before restrictions, about 50 hours remained accessible at noncompliant sites that never restricted access, 30 hours persisted through VPN-based circumvention, 10 hours were substituted from compliant sites to noncompliant sites, and 10 hours were no longer spent on adult sites.
abstract_zh: 网络监管的效果取决于用户规避限制或转向不合规平台的程度。自2023年以来，美国25个州实施了年龄验证法律，导致知名成人网站（包括Pornhub）对所有用户限制本地访问。我们利用个体层面面板数据研究了这些限制对浏览活动的影响。访问限制使成人网站总浏览时间减少约10%。具体而言，在限制实施前每100小时成人网站浏览时间中，约50小时仍可通过从未限制访问的不合规网站获取，30小时通过VPN规避持续存在，10小时从合规网站转向不合规网站，另有10小时不再用于访问成人网站。

title: Dynamic coordination with switching costs
title_zh: 具有转换成本的动态协调
title_primary: 具有转换成本的动态协调
title_secondary: Dynamic coordination with switching costs
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study dynamic coordination with costly switching, where players are initially uncertain regarding how to coordinate. We model two players searching for compatible platforms in the presence of two kinds of frictions: noisy outcomes and costly switching. The model predicts that players remain on their current platforms whenever their common belief is sufficiently optimistic; otherwise, they randomize their actions, switching with higher probability whenever they are more pessimistic about compatibility, switching is less costly, or success conditional on compatibility is more likely. In an experiment, we vary (i) whether success is Deterministic or Stochastic when players are on compatible platforms and (ii) the cost of switching. We allow subjects to choose explicit mixed strategies to provide a better test of the theory. The data are consistent with most comparative statics predictions, particularly in the Deterministic case, but differ from some of the other theoretical predictions. To explain the disparities between theory and the data, particularly when learning is noisy and switching is costly, we discuss the impacts of several factors, including cognitive ability, inattention, sensitivity to recent failures, and experience.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在昂贵转换成本的动态协调问题，其中参与者最初对于如何协调存在不确定性。我们构建了一个模型，涉及两名参与者在两种摩擦条件下寻找兼容平台：结果的不确定性和转换成本的高昂。模型预测，当参与者的共同信念足够乐观时，他们会留在当前平台；否则，他们会随机化行动，且在以下情况下更可能以更高概率转换：对兼容性的悲观程度增加、转换成本降低，或兼容条件下成功的可能性增大。在实验中，我们操纵了两个变量：（i）当参与者处于兼容平台时，成功结果是确定性的还是随机性的；（ii）转换成本的高低。我们允许受试者选择明确的混合策略，以更严格地检验理论。数据与大多数比较静态预测相符，尤其是在确定性情形下，但与其他一些理论预测存在差异。为解释理论与数据之间的偏差，特别是在学习过程伴随噪声且转换成本高昂的情况下，我们探讨了包括认知能力、注意力不集中、对近期失败的敏感度以及经验在内的多种因素的影响。

title: Microeconomic Linkages Between Food, Energy, and Land Security: Insights From Ethiopia
title_zh: 粮食、能源与土地安全的微观经济关联：来自埃塞俄比亚的启示
title_primary: 粮食、能源与土地安全的微观经济关联：来自埃塞俄比亚的启示
title_secondary: Microeconomic Linkages Between Food, Energy, and Land Security: Insights From Ethiopia
authors: Tinne Sauer, Dalia Fadly, Miet Maertens
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Rural households in low‐income countries face food and energy insecurity. This study examines how land tenure security shapes these interlinked outcomes in southern Ethiopia. We introduce the Household Energy Insecurity Access Scale ( HEIAS ), adapted from experience‐based food security indicators, to measure energy security. Using survey data from 803 households and a multiple mediation model, we find a direct positive effect of land tenure security on energy security and an indirect effect on food security, which improves through enset cultivation and livestock ownership. HEIAS offers a practical tool to quantify household energy security that can support monitoring, targeting, and policy evaluation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 低收入国家的农村家庭面临食物和能源不安全问题。本研究探讨了土地权属保障如何影响埃塞俄比亚南部这些相互关联的结果。我们引入了家庭能源不安全获取量表（HEIAS），该量表改编自基于经验的食物安全指标，用以衡量能源安全。利用803户家庭的调查数据和多重中介模型，我们发现土地权属保障对能源安全有直接正向影响，并通过苔麸种植和牲畜所有权对食物安全产生间接效应。HEIAS提供了一种实用的工具来量化家庭能源安全，可支持监测、目标定位和政策评估。

title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据
title_primary: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据
title_secondary: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
authors: Jiawen Liu, Michael Olabisi, Mywish K Maredia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。

title: Cross Ownership Versus Merger Under Product Differentiation
title_zh: 产品差异化下的交叉持股与并购
title_primary: 产品差异化下的交叉持股与并购
title_secondary: Cross Ownership Versus Merger Under Product Differentiation
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We compare the merger participants' profits under a merger and under cross ownership (CO) in an oligopolistic industry with horizontally differentiated products. We show under Cournot competition that the merger participants would be better off under a symmetric CO than a merger. This result holds under symmetric and asymmetric costs. Considering a unilateral CO under Cournot competition, we show that the participating firms may prefer CO compared to a merger under asymmetric CO. We further show under Cournot competition that a symmetric CO may create higher consumer surplus and welfare compared to both merger and noncooperation in the presence of cost asymmetry and technology transfer between the firms engaging in CO or merger. If there is Bertrand competition, we show that the merger participants will not be better off under a symmetric CO than a merger.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了在水平差异化产品的寡头垄断行业中，合并与交叉持股（CO）下合并参与者的利润。我们表明，在古诺竞争下，合并参与者在对称交叉持股下的境况优于合并。这一结果在成本对称和不对称的情况下均成立。考虑古诺竞争下的单边交叉持股，我们显示，在不对称交叉持股下，参与企业可能更偏好交叉持股而非合并。我们进一步表明，在古诺竞争下，当存在成本不对称以及参与交叉持股或合并的企业间技术转移时，对称交叉持股可能比合并和非合作产生更高的消费者剩余和福利。若存在伯特兰竞争，我们显示，合并参与者在对称交叉持股下的境况不会优于合并。

title: Consistency, distributional convergence, and optimality of time-varying parameters in score-driven models
title_zh: 得分驱动模型中时变参数的一致性、分布收敛性与最优性
title_primary: 得分驱动模型中时变参数的一致性、分布收敛性与最优性
title_secondary: Consistency, distributional convergence, and optimality of time-varying parameters in score-driven models
authors: Eric Beutner, Yicong Lin, Andre Lucas
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-04-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Observation-driven models for time series have a long history in statistics and econometrics, but are typically studied under the assumption of correct dynamic specification. We develop an in-fill asymptotic framework to study the limiting behavior of the estimated (i.e., filtered) time-varying parameter paths obtained with such models in (severely) mis-specified settings. We show that despite such mis-specification, the filtered paths, particularly those from the class of score-driven models of Creal et al. (2011, 2013) and Harvey (2013), still converge in probability to the Kullback-Leibler optimal time-varying parameter paths, even in severely mis-specified settings. We obtain distributional convergence results for the filtering errors and formulate the observation-driven filter that minimizes the asymptotic filter error variance. Such an optimal filter again has score-driven features. The results substantially generalize earlier findings, which we demonstrate by applying the new theory to time-varying tail shape models, dynamic copulas, and time-varying regression models. We further highlight the practical relevance of the asymptotic results by using them to construct pointwise intervals that quantify the uncertainty of filtered parameter paths based on observation-driven filters and apply these to the volatility path of intraday Pfizer log-returns.
abstract_zh: 时间序列的观测驱动模型在统计学和计量经济学中有着悠久的历史，但通常是在正确动态设定的假设下进行研究。我们发展了一个填充渐近框架，以研究在（严重）误设定情形下，此类模型所估计（即滤波）的时变参数路径的极限行为。我们表明，尽管存在这种误设定，滤波路径——尤其是来自Creal等人（2011, 2013）和Harvey（2013）的得分驱动模型类——即使在严重误设定情形下，仍以概率收敛于Kullback-Leibler最优时变参数路径。我们获得了滤波误差的分布收敛结果，并构建了最小化渐近滤波误差方差的观测驱动滤波器。这种最优滤波器同样具有得分驱动的特征。这些结果大幅推广了早期发现，我们通过将新理论应用于时变尾部形状模型、动态copula和时变回归模型来加以证明。我们进一步通过利用这些渐近结果构建点态区间来突出其实践相关性，这些区间量化了基于观测驱动滤波器的滤波参数路径的不确定性，并将其应用于辉瑞公司日内对数收益的波动率路径。

title: Shrinkage Estimation and Identification of Latent Group Structures in Panel Data with Interactive Fixed Effects
title_zh: 面板数据交互固定效应下潜在群组结构的收缩估计与识别
title_primary: 面板数据交互固定效应下潜在群组结构的收缩估计与识别
title_secondary: Shrinkage Estimation and Identification of Latent Group Structures in Panel Data with Interactive Fixed Effects
official: 官方在线 2026-01-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides a framework for joint shrinkage estimation and identification of latent group structures in panel data models with interactive fixed effects and large number of explanatory variables. The latent structure of the model allows individuals to be classified into a number of groups where the number of groups and/or each individual’s group identity are unknown. A doubly penalized principal component estimation procedure using a pairwise fusion penalty and an adaptive LASSO (least absolute shrinkage and selection operator) penalty is introduced to detect the latent group structure and select the relevant regressors. To implement the proposed approach, an alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm has been developed. The proposed method is further illustrated by simulation studies and an empirical application of economic growth across various countries which demonstrate the good performance of the method.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个联合收缩估计与潜在群组结构识别的框架，适用于具有交互固定效应及大量解释变量的面板数据模型。该模型的潜在结构允许个体被划分为若干群组，其中群组数量和/或每个个体的群组归属未知。我们引入了一种双重惩罚主成分估计方法，结合成对融合惩罚与自适应LASSO（最小绝对收缩和选择算子）惩罚，以检测潜在群组结构并筛选相关回归变量。为实施所提方法，开发了交替方向乘子法算法。通过模拟研究及跨国经济增长的实证应用，进一步展示了所提方法的良好性能。

title: Machine learning and infant mortality: predictive models for health policy in Brazil
title_zh: 机器学习与婴儿死亡率：巴西卫生政策的预测模型
title_primary: 机器学习与婴儿死亡率：巴西卫生政策的预测模型
title_secondary: Machine learning and infant mortality: predictive models for health policy in Brazil
authors: Leonardo Matsuno da Frota Marcos Minoru Hasegawa Paulo de Andrade Jacinto Economics, Federal University of Paraná – UFPR, Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil
official: 官方在线 2025-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The persistence of infant mortality in middle-income countries, such as Brazil, is a critical health challenge in the twenty-first century. Healthcare policymakers increasingly use statistical methods such as survival analysis to identify factors associated with mortality rates. Using 2.9 million observations from the Brazilian Unique Health System (SUS) 2017, we estimated a set of different machine learning models (Survival Support Vector Machines, Random Survival Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting) to predict which infants have the highest risk of not surviving the first year of life. The SHAP framework of interpretable machine learning was used to identify factors affecting infant mortality rates in Brazil. Factors such as caesarean sections and gestational weeks affect mortality nonlinearly and mean variable effects, found in standard survival regression models, can be misleading. Finally, we argue that interpretable machine learning models can support policymakers in designing health policies and screening frameworks that address the challenge of infant mortality in middle-income countries.
abstract_zh: 中等收入国家（如巴西）婴儿死亡率的持续存在是二十一世纪面临的一项关键健康挑战。医疗政策制定者越来越多地运用生存分析等统计方法来识别与死亡率相关的因素。利用巴西统一卫生系统（SUS）2017年的290万条观测数据，我们估计了一系列不同的机器学习模型（生存支持向量机、随机生存森林和极限梯度提升），以预测哪些婴儿在生命第一年内无法存活的风险最高。采用可解释机器学习的SHAP框架来识别影响巴西婴儿死亡率的因素。剖宫产和孕周等因素对死亡率的影响呈非线性，而标准生存回归模型中发现的平均变量效应可能具有误导性。最后，我们认为，可解释的机器学习模型能够支持政策制定者设计应对中等收入国家婴儿死亡率挑战的健康政策和筛查框架。
